tagline.en: YUME — an interactive world model that turns an image or video into a world you can explore, with 540P and 720P variants.
tagline.zh: YUME——一个交互式世界模型，把图像或视频转化为你可探索的世界，提供 540P 与 720P 两种变体。

en: YUME is an interactive world-video model. Given a conditioning image or video, it generates an explorable world, so instead of a fixed clip you get a scene you can move through and interact with.

It ships in two forms: YUME I2V at 540P for image-to-world generation, and the larger YUME-1.5 5B at 720P, which also accepts text alongside image or video conditioning. Both come with open code and weights, hosted on Hugging Face under stdstu123.
In WorldFoundry both variants run through a shared in-tree pipeline and a unified environment, so you can switch between the 540P and 720P routes without changing setup.
zh: YUME 是一个交互式世界视频模型。给它一张条件图像或一段视频，它便生成一个可探索的世界——你得到的不是固定片段，而是一个可以穿行、可以交互的场景。
它提供两种形态：面向图生世界的 YUME I2V（540P），以及更大的 YUME-1.5 5B（720P），后者还可在图像或视频条件之外接受文本。两者均开放代码与权重，托管于 Hugging Face 的 stdstu123 下。
在 WorldFoundry 中，两个变体都通过共享的内置 pipeline 与统一环境运行，你无需改动配置即可在 540P 与 720P 路线间切换。

whenToUse.en: Use YUME when you want to turn an image (or video) into an interactive, explorable world — pick 540P I2V for lighter runs or the 720P 5B variant for higher resolution and text conditioning.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张图（或一段视频）变成可交互、可探索的世界时，选择 YUME——较轻量选 540P I2V，追求更高分辨率与文本条件则选 720P 的 5B 变体。

notFor.en: Built around interactive world exploration rather than one-shot text-to-video; you stage its weights from Hugging Face first.
notFor.zh: 围绕交互式世界探索构建，而非一次性文生视频；需先从 Hugging Face 准备好权重。

en: Interactive, explorable world generation from image or video
Open code and weights on Hugging Face
zh: 从图像或视频生成可交互、可探索的世界
720P 变体还可接受文本条件
开放代码与权重，托管于 Hugging Face
